# Paths whose private-key material is known to be PUBLIC test data, one glob
# per line. Every entry needs a reason; nothing generated at build time or
# by a tool run during the build belongs here.
#
# GSConnect ships its test suite with fixed test keys, published in its
# repository (andyholmes/gnome-shell-extension-gsconnect, installed-tests/
# data). Bluefin bakes the extension, tests included.
usr/libexec/installed-tests/gsconnect/data/*-private.pem
usr/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gsconnect@andyholmes.github.io/installed-tests/data/*-private.pem
